entry.title: Easier to see and to tap: links keep a clearer underline, and "Low relevance" is an outline square
entry.summary: Links in lists and tables are at least 24 pixels high; the rating "Low relevance" no longer looks like "Monitor", on the pages and in the timeline drawings.

entry.title: Easier to read on phones and tablets: wide tables as one block per entry, long tables folded
entry.summary: The timeline on a phone opens at today; dates no longer break across lines; links to other sites open in a new tab with ↗; drawings are dimmed in dark mode.

entry.title: New: who may speak for SMEs, consumers, the environment and workers in European standardisation
entry.summary: The criteria of the proposed Standardisation Regulation for the four European stakeholder organisations, side by side with today's, and the organisations that could be designated.

entry.title: The texts are now grouped by act, and the latest activity opens with the last 14 days
entry.summary: Each act with its texts and its zip; acts are called by their name throughout; the committees and standardisation pages open with the next meeting and the next deadline.

entry.title: New: an About page, and how to credit the graphics when you reuse them
entry.summary: A private spare-time project by Steffen Zimmermann. Everything stays free under CC BY 4.0; every graphic now carries a short credit line.

entry.title: New: how long an EU law takes, two charts on the Graphics tab
entry.summary: Each phase of the procedure, and the share of proposals published after n months, from every file since 2014; in English and German, for slides.

entry.title: New: the Forecast tab, when open EU procedures are likely to become law
entry.summary: For every open procedure and the announced European Product Act, measured against how long comparable laws took and the 2029 elections.

entry.title: New: which files change the product laws under the New Legislative Framework, side by side
entry.summary: Next to the announced European Product Act, 24 of 31 product laws are already being changed by other files; and every forecast chart is now on the Graphics tab.

entry.title: New: the rapporteurs of the ETSI standards for the CRA, and every change of rapporteur
entry.summary: The act page names the rapporteur of each ETSI project; the news report a new rapporteur like a new status.

entry.title: New: the Regulation Desk, the most important changes of the last 14 days
entry.summary: Stories from the registers and our analysis, in English and German, with Atom feeds per desk and topic.

entry.title: New: a page for the Standardisation Regulation and a topic page on harmonised standards
entry.summary: Dates, texts and what the proposal changes for the CRA, the Machinery Regulation and the AI Act.
